comparison.objective: Candidate sets a prescribed opening limit and locks it; this record seats a started bracket bolt using a ratchet in confined access.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses two concentric tools simultaneously to preserve an adjustment; the record uses repeated short ratchet drive/return strokes on one fastener.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate verifies stop retention through three gripper cycles; the record checks bolt seating, with ratchet cycling or torque treated according to its version.
comparison.reason: Both involve rotary tools, but bolt advancement with a one-way ratchet does not test preserving an adjustable stop while locking a jam nut.
